close_gloss: And God finished on the seventh day his work which he had done, and he ceased on the seventh day from all his work which he had done.

context.text: And God saw all that he had made, and behold, it was very good. And there was evening and there was morning, the sixth day.
Thus the heavens and the earth were finished[b][a], and all their hosts.
So God blessed the seventh day and made it holy[d][c][b][a], because on it he rested from all his work that God had created to make.
